_comment: Ordered, mechanical Claude -> Copilot rewrites applied to PASSTHROUGH text only.
Order matters: the longest paths rewrite first, and the .agent.md suffix regex runs
AFTER the directory rewrite that produces the paths it matches.
Text inside an ai:block override is NOT substituted - an override is authored
already-Copilot-shaped, and silently rewriting it would hide what it actually says.
`leakage` is the safety net: any of these PATTERNS matching passthrough-derived output
is a generator ERROR, because it means a Claude-only spelling reached the Copilot tree
through a substitution nobody remembered to add. They are regexes, and they deliberately
match a PATH (`.claude/<name>`) rather than a bare mention: prose that names `.claude/`
as a directory - a historical ledger row about the config-trust surface, say - is honest
cross-reference, while `.claude/commands` in a Copilot file points the reader at a tree

substitutions.pattern: A cheap Haiku scout triages and routes; an Opus council reviews complex changes with up to 3 scout-selected domain specialists; a blind-first Fable red-team, on a tier no voting seat uses, executes repros (C7) and gates.
substitutions.replace: A cheap scout triages and routes; a frontier council reviews complex changes with up to 3 scout-selected domain specialists; a blind-first, VENDOR-DECORRELATED red-team executes repros (C7) and gates.
